mapper.select: SELECT r.id, CASE r.request_type WHEN 'ONBOARDING' THEN '入职申请' WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN '转岗调动申请' WHEN 'LEAVE' THEN '请假申请' WHEN 'OFFBOARDING' THEN '离职交接申请' ELSE '人事申请' END AS title, r.id AS resource_id, r.employee_id, r.status, NULL AS due_at, r.created_at FROM hr_request r WHERE () AND ((r.status = 'PENDING_DEPT_APPROVAL' AND r.current_node = 'DEPARTMENT' AND #{allowDepartmentApproval} = TRUE) OR (r.status = 'PENDING_HR_APPROVAL' AND r.current_node = 'HR' AND #{allowHrApproval} = TRUE)) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.id, 'OCR识别失败' AS title, v.id AS resource_id, e.id AS employee_id, b.status, NULL AS due_at, b.updated_at AS created_at FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.archive_version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id WHERE b.status = 'FAILED' AND ( 1 = 1 e.department_id = #{departmentId} e.id = #{employeeId} 1 = 0 ) ORDER BY b.updated_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
